chat.text: Help me please!! I can't breathe... I can't breathe. My chest is so tight and my heart is racing and I think I'm actually dying. I'm completely alone and I can't even move my hands to pick up my phone. Please, you have to do something, I'm having a heart attack or something, I can't breathe!!
